product_overview: Indo Global Education is a public-facing education consultancy website that helps prospective medical students explore MBBS study options across multiple countries. Visitors can browse informational pages, read blog/news updates, view galleries and FAQs, and submit enquiry requests through the contact form.
core_goals: Browse the public homepage and informational country pages
Submit a course enquiry through the contact form
Explore public blog and news listings
Find answers through the FAQ section
Access contact details, map location, and legal policy pages
Use public navigation across desktop and mobile layouts
Open the WhatsApp chat link from public pages

features.name: Public Navigation
features.description: Visitors can move across the main public pages using the navbar, footer, browser history, and mobile menu.
user_flows: Open / -> View the homepage content -> Use the public navigation to visit /about -> See the about page content
Open / -> Use the public navigation to visit /mbbs-in-india -> See the India MBBS information page
Open / -> Use the public navigation to visit /mbbs-in-russia -> See the Russia MBBS information page
Open / -> Scroll to the footer -> Use footer links to visit /contact-us -> See the contact page content
Open / -> Open the mobile menu in a small viewport -> Choose a public destination -> See the selected page load and the menu remain usable
Open / -> Visit /about -> Visit /contact-us -> Use browser back and forward -> See the previously visited public pages restore correctly

features.name: Contact Enquiry Form
features.description: Visitors can submit a compact enquiry with personal, course, and preference details, and receive validation feedback or submission status.
user_flows: Open /contact-us -> View the enquiry form -> Fill in valid name, email, phone, address, course, college name, how heard, and preferences -> Submit the form -> See a success message -> See the form reset
Open /contact-us -> Leave required fields empty -> Submit the form -> See validation errors and no submission occur
Open /contact-us -> Enter an invalid email address -> Complete the remaining fields -> Submit the form -> See an email validation error
Open /contact-us -> Enter an invalid phone number -> Complete the remaining fields -> Submit the form -> See a phone validation error
Open /contact-us -> Select a course value -> Observe the selected course remains visible
Open /contact-us -> Select an option for how heard -> Observe the selected value remains visible
Open /contact-us -> Submit a valid enquiry that matches an existing record -> See a duplicate enquiry message

features.name: WhatsApp Widget
features.description: Visitors can access a floating WhatsApp contact link from public pages.
user_flows: Open / -> View the floating WhatsApp widget -> Inspect the link destination -> Confirm it points to https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=91709000502
Open /about -> View the WhatsApp widget on the page -> Confirm the contact link remains available
Open /contact-us -> View the WhatsApp widget on the page -> Confirm the contact link remains available

features.name: Public Blog and News
features.description: Visitors can browse public blog and news listings and see loading, empty, and populated states.
user_flows: Open /blog -> View loading feedback -> See blog cards when records are available
Open /blog -> View an empty state when no records are returned
Open /blog -> View a user-visible error state when records are unavailable
Open /news -> View loading feedback -> See news cards when records are available
Open /news -> View an empty state when no records are returned
Open /news -> View a user-visible error state when records are unavailable

features.name: FAQ Accordion
features.description: Visitors can browse questions and expand or collapse answers on the FAQ page.
user_flows: Open /faqs -> View the list of FAQ questions -> Expand a question -> See the answer appear
Open /faqs -> Expand one FAQ item -> Collapse it or open another item -> See accordion behavior update

features.name: Galleries
features.description: Visitors can browse photo and video galleries and open media in modals.
user_flows: Open /photo-gallery -> View gallery images -> Select an image -> See the image modal open -> Close the modal -> Return to the gallery
Open /video-gallery -> View video thumbnails or cards -> Select a video item -> See the video modal open -> Close the modal -> Return to the gallery

features.name: Contact Page Information
features.description: Visitors can view contact details and the embedded office map on the contact page.
user_flows: Open /contact-us -> View phone, email, office address, working hours, enquiry form, and map area -> See the Google Maps iframe titled Office Location
Open /contact-us -> View the map area -> Confirm the embedded map is present without leaving the site

features.name: Legal Pages
features.description: Visitors can read the site’s policy and disclaimer pages.
user_flows: Open /privacy-policy -> Read the privacy policy content
Open /cookie-policy -> Read the cookie policy content
Open /terms-and-conditions -> Read the terms and conditions content
Open /disclaimer -> Read the disclaimer content
Open one legal page -> Use footer navigation to visit another legal page -> See the new policy page load

features.name: Country Landing Pages
features.description: Visitors can explore MBBS information pages for different countries and access their primary calls to action.
user_flows: Open /mbbs-in-india -> View the India MBBS landing page content -> Observe the primary CTA
Open /mbbs-in-russia -> View the Russia MBBS landing page content -> Observe the primary CTA
Open /mbbs-in-armenia -> View the Armenia MBBS landing page content -> Observe the primary CTA
Open /mbbs-in-georgia -> View the Georgia MBBS landing page content -> Observe the primary CTA

active_test_scope.name: Public Frontend Only

routes.description: Public blog listing backed by Supabase reads
Public news listing backed by Supabase reads
Public photo gallery with image modal
Public video gallery with video modal
Public contact page with compact enquiry form and Google Maps iframe

features.name: Contact Enquiry Form
behavior: validates name, email, phone, address, course, college, how-heard, and preferences
inserts into Supabase when valid and unique
sends webhook in non-blocking no-cors mode
shows success, duplicate, validation, and insert-error states

features.name: WhatsApp Widget
features.test_rule: inspect href and target attributes; do not navigate externally

features.name: Google Maps Embed
features.test_rule: verify iframe presence only; do not interact with external map content

features.name: Public Blog and News
behavior: render loading, empty, error, and populated states
features.test_rule: mock records for deterministic UI states

features.name: Public Navigation
behavior: desktop navbar, footer links, browser history, and mobile menu navigate public routes
